shortdesc.ph: Starts the audio recording device test.
Starts the audio capturing device test.

section.p: After calling this method, the SDK triggers the callback at the set interval, reporting uid = 0 and the volume of the recording device. This differs from in that only checks the local recording device, while also checks video devices and network.
section.note: Call this method before joining a channel. After the test, call before joining a channel to stop the test.
section.p: This method tests whether the audio capturing device works properly. After calling this method, the SDK triggers the callback at the time interval set in this method, which reports uid = 0 and the volume information of the capturing device.

The difference between this method and the method is that the former checks if the local audio capturing device is working properly, while the latter can check the audio and video devices and network conditions.
section.note: Call this method before joining a channel. After the test is completed, call to stop the test before joining a channel.

plentry.pd: Interval (ms) for triggering . Must be greater than 10, otherwise the callback won't be triggered and the SDK returns error -2. Recommended: 100.

The interval (ms) for triggering the callback. This value should be set to greater than 10, otherwise, you will not receive the callback and the SDK returns the error code -2. Agora recommends that you set this value to 100.
